question: Removal of moisture from the air, without change in its dry bulb temperature (DBT), is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Dehumidification**(option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dehumidification__ refers to the removal of moisture from the air without altering its dry bulb temperature.
 
• It is a crucial process in air conditioning systems and helps in maintaining indoor air quality.
 
• Dehumidification is often achieved using devices such as dehumidifiers or air conditioning systems.
 
• The process ensures comfort by reducing the humidity level in an enclosed space.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Latent Heat:**

 
 
• Latent heat is the heat required to change the phase of a substance without changing its temperature.
 
• Examples include the energy needed for water to evaporate or freeze.
 
 
 
• **Humidification:**
 
 
• Humidification is the process of adding moisture to the air.
 
• It helps in maintaining comfortable humidity levels indoors, especially in dry climates or during winter.
 
 
 
• **Sensible Heat:**
 
 
• Sensible heat refers to the heat exchanged by a substance resulting in a temperature change.
 
• It does not involve any phase change.
